'''Mini rockets''' were employed as a weapon by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors as of [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. These rockets were small, capable of homing in on individual or even multiple targets, and were launched in clusters from the Mandalorian's gauntlet. Mandalorians employed mini rockets when [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] hired them for a [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|raid]] on the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] in 43.5 ABY.
